senses.sense_definition: Половина учебного года в высших и средних специальных учебных заведениях.

examples.text: Студенты готовятся к экзаменам в конце <w>семестра</w>.

target_lang_translations.en: Students are preparing for exams at the end of the <w>semester</w>.

examples.text: Наш первый <w>семестр</w> в университете был очень насыщенным.

target_lang_translations.en: Our first <w>semester</w> at university was very busy.

target_lang_definitions.en: One of the two main periods that an academic year is divided into at a university or college.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: Common in US and some international academic systems for a half-year term.
Common in UK and other academic systems for a division of the school year.
